uctalent.summary: HRTech product team building a talent marketplace, recruiter workspace, and AI-assisted search and matching workflows.

bullets.production: Owned full-stack delivery for marketplace and recruiter workflows, including candidate sourcing, pipelines, and referral flows.
bullets.performance: Built AI-assisted screening and matching plus semantic search with LLM tooling, embeddings, and Elasticsearch.
bullets.reliability: Shipped Next.js experiences and NestJS/FastAPI services over GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch.
bullets.endToEnd: Connected search, matching, background jobs, and notifications across service boundaries with production fallbacks.
bullets.agile: Took features from product/design handoff through implementation, review, release, and production debugging.

fsoft.summary: Three-month on-the-job training internship — built a school grading / learning-management project for the university program.

bullets.ojt: Delivered an OJT project for school grading and learning management used in the internship evaluation.
bullets.fullstack: Built full-stack features with a Spring Boot (Java) API and a Vite + React frontend (Tailwind).
bullets.delivery: Worked in a 3-month internship cadence — requirements, implementation, and demo handoff.

guscent.title: Guscent
guscent.summary: A design-led perfume storefront that turns mood-based storytelling and a scent quiz into a clear product-discovery and commerce journey.

highlights.shipped: Production Next.js storefront, scent quiz, catalog/cart journeys, and reusable editorial and product sections.
highlights.decisions: Translated visual art direction into responsive, accessible components and resilient API/CMS loading, empty, and error states.
highlights.impact: Production launch with a responsive implementation, reusable UI, and backend/CMS integration.

uctalent.title: uctalent.io
uctalent.summary: HRTech talent marketplace and recruiter workspace for sourcing, pipelines, AI-assisted matching, semantic search, and referral flows.

highlights.shipped: Marketplace and recruiter workflows for sourcing, candidate pipelines, screening, matching, outreach, and referrals.
highlights.decisions: Combined Elasticsearch and vector embeddings for semantic search; integrated Next.js with NestJS/FastAPI services through GraphQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and background jobs.
highlights.impact: Production HRTech products with shared search/matching architecture and full-stack technical ownership.

unchainlabs.title: Unchain Labs
unchainlabs.summary: A production marketing site and headless CMS that lets the team publish structured business content without frontend rework.

highlights.shipped: Next.js frontend, Strapi CMS, reusable page sections, media/content workflows, and validated contact flows.
highlights.decisions: Used SSR and REST integration with semantic HTML, metadata, Open Graph, sitemap, robots, and environment-based configuration.
highlights.impact: Production launch with SEO-ready architecture, responsive components, and CMS ownership for non-developers.

matchtutors.title: Match Tutors
matchtutors.summary: A tutor–student marketplace that brings profiles, scheduling, AI-assisted matching, realtime chat, and payments into one workflow.

highlights.shipped: Profiles, scheduling, learning workflows, PayOS checkout, JWT/Google OAuth, file uploads, and realtime messaging.
highlights.decisions: Used OpenAI embeddings with Redis/BullMQ workers for matching and Socket.io for live booking and chat updates across separate React and Express repos.
highlights.impact: Deployed production builds on AWS with real-time functionality and an asynchronous matching architecture.
